title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a closed loop. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Then, draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0571). Continue with the third line from (0.75, 0.0571) to (0.0, 0.0571), and finish the loop by drawing the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0571) back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles as initially set, and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the scaled and transformed sketch 0.0245 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate this newly created solid body with any previous bodies to form the first part of the final cylindrical structure with rounded edges. The dimensions of this part are 0.75 units in length, 0.0571 units in width, and 0.0245 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0571) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0571) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.0245)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
